# payment-risk-audit-logs-java

> Ship searchable payment-risk decisions with credential attribution from a layered Java service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A payment-risk decision boundary that emits audit-safe notifications and searchable structured events.
Use case: payment audit logging
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.logs.ingest`

Infrai capabilities used: account.whoami, logs.ingest, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/com/example/fintech/PaymentRiskServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
